prompts.name: manor-stage.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game background. Draw a finished 1536x1024 landscape game stage, no text or people. Don't Starve inspired hand drawn crooked gothic ink linework, scratchy hatching, flat paper cutout props viewed obliquely from above, muted charcoal olive sepia parchment with restrained warm candle glow. A lonely occult manor study, diamond-perspective worn wooden floor occupying most of frame with broad EMPTY WALKABLE foreground and center. At upper left a tall crooked bookshelf and curtained narrow window, upper right a writing desk with loose blank papers and candle, at rear center a standing notice board with single blank sheet, at left-middle a small chess table with two empty chairs and clearly checkered chess board. Room has no front wall, dark irregular edges disappearing into charcoal shadow, composed like a 2D game diorama, not a realistic 3D render. Props confined largely to rear/top third and side edges, center stays empty for movable sprites. No UI, no lettering, no characters, no creatures. Entire room fits frame.

prompts.name: wilson-walk.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite sheet, 1536x1024. Draw Wilson from Don't Starve as a gothic detective with swept tall black hair, ivory face, white shirt, burgundy waistcoat, dark trousers. Same hand-drawn scratchy black ink paper cutout style as Don't Starve, orthographic slightly overhead game camera. EXACT grid 8 columns by 3 rows, 24 complete isolated full-body sprites, each centered in its equally sized cell, same scale, feet at same cell baseline, generous transparent margins, NO labels or grid lines. Each COLUMN is direction: column 1 facing south toward camera, 2 southwest, 3 west profile, 4 northwest back three-quarter, 5 north full back, 6 northeast back three-quarter, 7 east profile, 8 southeast. Each ROW is a different WALK CYCLE keyframe: row 1 left foot forward right arm forward; row 2 feet passing neutral upright; row 3 right foot forward left arm forward. Distinct alternating leg and arm poses. Consistent character size and identity. Real transparent alpha background. No ground, no cast shadows, no objects, no UI, no text. All 24 sprites separated with no overlap, aligned regular cell grid.

prompts.name: maxwell-walk.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite sheet. 1536x1024, exact 8 columns x 3 rows, 24 separate full body sprites evenly centered in equal cells, no lines or labels. Maxwell from Don't Starve as a devil earl, tall angular head, swept black pompadour, pointed beard, ivory skin, pinstripe black suit, white shirt, red rose, thin long limbs. Scratchy ink hand-drawn 2D flat cutout style, slight overhead game view. Each column has exact direction: south front, southwest, west profile, northwest rear three-quarter, north full back, northeast rear three-quarter, east profile, southeast. Row1 walking left foot forward; row2 feet together passing neutral; row3 walking right foot forward. Actual distinct arm and leg poses, all frames same size and baseline, generous padding. Background MUST be perfectly flat solid pure white RGB 255 255 255, absolutely no gradient, no shadows, no vignette or paper texture outside characters. White background for runtime chroma key. Black continuous outlines. No props, no scenery, no typography.

prompts.name: gray-walk.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: 1536x1024 production game sprite atlas. EXACT grid 8 columns 3 rows, 24 isolated full body gray anonymous human mannequin sprites, charcoal sketch ink outline, flat light gray clothing and gray featureless oval head with small nose to indicate facing, no hair, no special accessories. Slight overhead Don't Starve paper cutout game drawing style. Each column direction: south toward viewer, southwest, west profile, northwest rear, north back, northeast rear, east profile, southeast. Row1 walking left foot forward; row2 neutral feet passing; row3 right foot forward. Equal cell spacing, same scale, feet on matching baselines, completely separated and generous margins. Pure flat WHITE #ffffff background for runtime chroma key, no shadows, gradients or texture outside figures. No text, no cell borders, no scenery. Anonymous gray stand-in shared by all NPCs and mental simulation doll.

prompts.name: story-actions.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: game ACTION sprite sheet 1536x1024. STRICT 6 columns by 3 rows = 18 separately isolated equally spaced vignettes, each contained in its cell, same size and foot baseline, generous white margins. Don't Starve hand drawn scratchy black ink, muted colors, ivory faces, slight overhead flat cutout. White pure flat background for runtime chroma key, no shadows outside sprites, no labels, no grid. Characters: Wilson black upward swept hair burgundy vest white shirt; Maxwell swept pompadour pointed beard black pinstripe suit red rose; companion plain gray featureless human. Row 1 columns 1-3 Wilson CAST sequence: 1 right hand raises small circular talisman to shoulder, 2 RIGHT hand holds talisman high overhead, 3 right hand fully extended overhead leaning back chanting. Row 1 cols4-6 Wilson THINK sequence: 4 seated leaning over a small narrow writing desk with papers, 5 hunched hand at temple, 6 startled looks up from desk. Row2 cols1-3 Maxwell RIP sequence: 1 holds sheet of paper in both hands, 2 tears it apart, 3 throws two ripped halves apart angrily open mouth. Row2 cols4-6 Maxwell INVITE sequence: 4 polite upright with folded hands, 5 one hand presenting to left, 6 deep courteous bow hand extended. Row3 cols1-3 CHESS sequence both Wilson left Maxwell right seated across one small chess table in each cell: 1 resting hands, 2 Wilson reaches over board moving a piece, 3 Maxwell reaches over board moving a piece. Row3 cols4-6 GRAY companion interrupt sequence: 4 plain gray human arm bent, 5 reaches one hand toward left, 6 both hands extended toward left urgent pose. NO background furniture except the small desk in Wilson think cells and chess table in chess cells. Each cell separated with at least 20 pixels white space. All 18 cells have complete uncut figures.
